dedupe_keys.name: ihme global burden of disease gbd results deaths disability and risk attributable burden for 204 countries and territories

description: This resource is the results database of the Global Burden of Disease study, which estimates deaths, years of life lost, years lived with disability, disability-adjusted life years, prevalence and incidence for hundreds of causes and risk factors. The Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation at the University of Washington produces it with a network of collaborators from 167 countries who vet data sources and estimates. The GBD 2023 round covers 375 diseases and injuries, 292 causes of death and 88 risk factors for 204 countries and territories and 660 subnational locations from 1990 to 2023, with demographic estimates back to 1950. Results are searched and downloaded as CSV through the GBD Results tool, with source listings and input data coverage maps on the Global Health Data Exchange. Use is free for non-commercial purposes under IHME's free-of-charge non-commercial user agreement. Caveats: figures are modelled estimates with uncertainty intervals, not counts, estimates are revised in each round so versions must not be mixed, and data-poor countries rely heavily on modelling. Simulation uses: setting baseline disease burden and injury rates for healthcare demand models, estimating health impacts of disasters and service disruptions, and weighting populations by vulnerability. Related records: the WHO Global Health Expenditure Database (data-who-global-health-expenditure-database) gives financing context and CDC NORS (data-cdc-nors-national-outbreak-reporting-system) records outbreak events.
